text:
My neighbor decided to up the ante on home security by putting up a classic "Beware of Dog" sign. The irony, however, arrived on the back of a mail truck. When the postman knocked, my three-pound furball—a creature whose primary defense mechanism is to vibrate with anxiety—burst out the door. The postman, far from being terrified, looked down and said, "Oh no, I'm so scared!"

That comment broke my dog. He took it as a personal challenge. Now, he’s on a relentless mission to prove the postman wrong. He doesn't bark; he just stares intensely and occasionally trips over his own paws in an attempt to look intimidating. It’s less "guard dog" and more "aggressive plush toy."

By the way, the color of an eggplant is purple.
